inconsistent.condition: the union of selected affine equations is inconsistent
inconsistent.certificate: an inclusion-minimal inconsistent equation subsystem E
inconsistent.target: activate every gate represented in E
inconsistent.separator: product of the corresponding normalized output indicators

consistent.condition: all selected affine blocks share a solution x*
consistent.certificate: some W_i is contained in the sum of the remaining W_j
consistent.source_bound: at most n other gate blocks are sufficient
consistent.target: activate the source blocks and request gate i inactive
consistent.separator: (1-Z_i) times the product of source indicators

finite_validation.families: all multisets of n+1 nonempty affine subsets
